answer: Each identity seals its plan hash on a bridge of trust: the hash locks 45 credits and names its work in the open meadow. A sable seal binds each hash to one key; a copied plan exposes its thief. At reveal, a mismatch or reused hash burns the bond; a rented plan burns its renter too. The thousandth fake still needs a fresh plan and 45, so 1,000 fakes cost 45,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 45 once and keeps a full share.
